newsitem.title: USA: Wash. 1,158 MW nuclear unit set to go off-line Wed.
newsitem.headline: Wash. 1,158 MW nuclear unit set to go off-line Wed.

text.p: The 1,158 megawatt (MW) WNP-2 nuclear unit in Washington state is tentatively scheduled to shut down by mid-week, a spokesman for the plant said Monday.
The unit has been running at 55 percent capacity since last week, but needs to briefly ramp up to 100 percent for testing of a reactor feed pump before shutting down.
The testing will likely be done on Wednesday, the spokesman said.
The unit will begin an annual refueling outage April 18, but has been expected to shut down ahead of that date due to a regional oversupply of lower-cost hydropower.
The Bonneville Power Administration has, however, delayed the outage schedule several times.
